title: Synthetic module that exercises a page with no ticket
tldr: `OrderForm` is the only entry point of the module.
The biggest trap: nothing checks the {{flag}} twice.
summary: The module turns a filled form into one order sent to `widget-api`.

glossary.what: A marker the server sets on an order.
glossary.why: It lets the server own one condition.

need: Every screen that creates an order goes through it.
